questionText: What counts as a 'structure point' for the minimum-of-one test - any candle body close beyond the level, or a swing high/low meeting some significance test? This source does not define it.
reason: The same undefined term already gates several existing ALEX_G rules and is the subject of cross-educator contradiction XCONTRA|20260729|001 (Alex G: any body close counts; Rayner Teo: only major swings). A quantified minimum over an undefined unit is still non-deterministic.
